description:
Can you really run multiple AI agents on the same project at the same time without chaos? In episode 5 of our beginner series, we show you how the GitHub Copilot app uses isolated git worktrees to keep parallel sessions completely separate. Learn how to track in-flight tasks on a centralized board, jump between distinct contexts, and review completed work at your own pace.  

Download the app today and try running two tasks at once: https://github.com/features/ai/github-app?utm_source=youtube-copilot-app-ep5-description&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=copilot-app-for-beginners-series
